ei.title: Cycling as a Symbol of Social Status
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: limiting → limited: be limited to(~에 국한되다) 수동태 필요

det.tip: be limited to = ~에 국한되다 (수동태 필수)

det.korean: what → which: 선행사 'an activity'가 있으므로 관계대명사 what 불가

det.korean: to impress → impressing: 전치사 in 뒤에 동명사 필요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① reinterpretation(재해석): 자전거의 상징적 재해석. 원문 일치

✅ ② poverty(빈곤): 자전거가 오랫동안 빈곤과 연관. 원문 일치

❌ ③ barrier(장벽): 원문은 marker(표지). 자전거는 부유층의 상징적 '표지'이지 '장벽'이 아님 ←정답

✅ ④ case(경우): 'in the case of cycling' 적절
det.tip: marker(표지/지표) ↔ barrier(장벽)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: inconspicuous(눈에 띄지 않는) → conspicuous(눈에 띄는): 과시적 소비 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① aspirational(열망하는): 고가 자전거가 열망의 대상으로 변함. 원문 일치

✅ ② demonstrative(과시적): 과시적 가치. 원문 일치

✅ ③ value-laden(가치가 담긴): 가치 지향적 소비 행동. 원문 일치

❌ ④ inconspicuous(눈에 띄지 않는): 원문은 conspicuous(과시적). 타인에게 과시하고 지위를 신호하는 맥락에서 눈에 띄어야 함 ←정답
det.tip: conspicuous consumption = 과시적 소비 ↔ inconspicuous(눈에 띄지 않는)

❌ ② essential commuting tools(필수 통근 도구): 빈곤 이미지에 가까운 표현

❌ ① environmental awareness(환경 인식): 환경 언급 없음

✅ ② conspicuous consumption: 원문 일치. 정체성 구성과 과시적 소비의 연결이 자전거에서 특히 두드러짐 ←정답

❌ ③ physical exercise(신체 운동): 운동 효과가 아닌 사회적 상징이 주제

❌ ④ community engagement(공동체 참여): 개인 지위 신호가 핵심

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for <u>its</u> demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.

❌ ③ 정체성 구성 — identity construction은 its의 수식을 받는 대상
